sql:
SELECT
    c.Occupation,
    count(DISTINCT f.CustomerKey) AS customer_count,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS total_revenue,
    sum(f.TotalCost) AS total_cost,
    sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS gross_profit,
    round(100.0 * sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) / sum(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS profit_margin_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE c.Occupation IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Occupation
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
